points.quote: a doc has one block tree, and page mode and edgeless mode are two views of it. Edgeless mode doesn't have a separate copy.
They are "elements" stored in the `affine:surface` block's `elements` prop.
Shapes, brush strokes, connectors, groups, mind maps and text are not blocks. They are "elements" stored in the `affine:surface` block's `elements` prop.
Page mode renders the notes as a linear document. ... Edgeless mode shows the same notes as movable cards on the canvas.
Some canvas items are real blocks that sit under `affine:surface`. These include frames, edgeless text, and bookmark and attachment cards. Notes can also sit under it.
every item has an `xywh` prop holding a serialized string such as `"[x,y,w,h]"`
every item has an `index` prop, a fractional-index string (default `'a0'`). Items are sorted by it, so inserting between two items only generates a new key
A `group` element ... keeps a `children` `Y.Map<boolean>` that maps child id → `true`. A `frame` block ... Frames also contain items by geometry.
